text: Underway in this season opener.
Zidroid calls to take the ball.
And Zidroid is clean through on goal right down the middle, nothing in the way!
Haalandroid bursts down the right.
Haalandroid slots it home from close range! The season's first goal belongs to Singularity United, they lead one-nil!
Haalandroid drives straight through the centre again, deep into the final third.
BellingRAM leaves Zidroid in a heap.
Zidroid quickly clatters into Haalandroid.
Oh dear, the Real Machina pair collide on the touchline and down goes CR-7000.
Haalandroid comes in firmly, tumbling Zidroid to the deck once again.
And it is turned into their own net by BellingRAM! Real Machina are level at one-all!
Zidroid loses balance entirely unprompted in the centre circle, but the righting mechanism should kick in soon enough.
BellingRAM calls across to look for the rebound off the wall on the flank.
A frantic moment right on the goal line, but the magenta ball just squirts wide of the post!
BellingRAM steps forward through the middle, making steady ground into midfield.
CR-7000 is through with an empty net ahead!
CR-7000 carries the ball purposefully down the right flank, closing in on the Singularity United goal.
Real Machina have really set up camp here in the attacking third, hemming the sky blues inside their own half.
BellingRAM finishes from close range! Against the run of play, Singularity United retake the lead, two goals to one!
CR-7000 calls to work it clear.
A wicked deflection nearly catches them out, brushing past the post!
BellingRAM bundles it into the net again! A two-goal cushion now for Singularity United, leading three-one.
CR-7000 shouts that the ball is wedged against the boards and needs a firm shove.
The corner panel thumps the ball right back into the mix.
Haalandroid calls for the ball.
BellingRAM pounces instantly at the goal mouth to poke it home! That makes it four-one to Singularity United.
And BellingRAM scores yet again right on the line! It is turning into a rout, five-one to the sky blues.
Zidroid advances into the final third, trying to salvage something for Real Machina.
The corner ram fires it away.
The Real Machina players collide again.
CR-7000 taps it in from point-blank range! Real Machina pull one back, five-two.
Zidroid takes another tumble in the centre circle, flat on the turf once more.
BellingRAM restores the four-goal lead with another tidy finish! Six-two to Singularity United.
Inches wide of the target.
BellingRAM flattens CR-7000.
BellingRAM calls to clear it.
That brings a breathless first half to a close. Singularity United lead Real Machina six goals to two.
CR-7000 trips over nothing in particular early in this second half, waiting for the motors to stand upright again.
The corner push-panel activates with a clunk, pinging the ball straight back off the perimeter.
Another mechanical shunt from the corner sends the magenta ball spinning into play.
Zidroid pounces and has a clear route towards the target from deep.
Zidroid strides all the way up the right channel, bearing down on goal.
Zidroid slips it into the corner! Real Machina reduce the deficit, but they still trail six-three.
A sharp effort whistles just wide of the post as Real Machina push forward.
The ram wall fires it out again.
BellingRAM finds space and is cleanly through on goal down the left channel.
Teammates collide and Zidroid drops.
BellingRAM signals it is trapped against the wall.
Zidroid gets a foot in and knocks Haalandroid flat on the deck near the touchline.
Singularity United maintain heavy pressure.
A close shave right in front.
Haalandroid nudges it in from point-blank range! Seven-three to Singularity United now.
CR-7000 is calling out to lever the ball off the perimeter boards in midfield.
BellingRAM sweeps home another tidy finish from two metres out! Eight goals to three for Singularity United.
CR-7000 drives forward along the right channel with time ticking away.
CR-7000 drives it low into the net! Real Machina pull another back, but it is eight-four.
BellingRAM upends Zidroid once more.
CR-7000 is through on goal again with clear turf ahead in the final minute.
BellingRAM overbalances and hits the deck, leaving the sky blue defence momentarily unmanned.
CR-7000 creeps toward the box.
Real Machina have Singularity United pinned back deep in these dying moments.
CR-7000 turns it in from two metres out! Real Machina grab a late consolation to make it eight-five.
Full time here. Singularity United take the opener eight-five against Real Machina in a chaotic spectacle.
